reviewMethod: Ordered ASR listening transcription plus pypinyin 0.55.0 default-reading syllable/tone comparison. Homophones require matching bases and tones; 一/不 sandhi and neutral-versus-citation notation are explicit exceptions. Alternate dictionary readings never pass a homograph. Both 呀 candidates were rejected as yā/yà, not neutral ya.
